home.title: Collect with your own payment codes, and know exactly what arrived
home.subtitle: Upload your Alipay, WeChat and QQ payment codes. The monitor app on your phone reports each incoming payment, orders are matched by exact amount, and your site is notified using the EPay protocol.

steps.create: Your site places an order via the EPay protocol
steps.pay: The buyer scans and pays at checkout
steps.receive: The monitor app reports the payment
steps.notify: Your site gets a callback once the amount matches

features.title: Everything collection needs, in one dashboard
features.subtitle: From payment codes and monitor devices to reconciliation and export, merchants configure it all themselves.

matching.title: Exact amount matching
matching.body: Each payment notice is matched by channel and amount to a single pending order, and one payment is never confirmed twice.

compat.title: EPay compatible
compat.body: Uses the familiar EPay order and callback formats, so an existing site connects with a few configuration changes.

device.title: Monitor device status
device.body: The Android monitor app sends regular heartbeats; the dashboard flags it clearly when offline, and payment codes follow the device state.

stats.title: Statistics and export
stats.body: View amounts and order counts by channel for the last 1, 7 or 30 days or a custom range, and export orders as CSV.

security.title: Account security
security.body: Optional two-step verification and API IP allowlist; changing the password or resetting the key requires an email code.

subscription.title: Pay as you go
subscription.body: Enable collection with a plan, renew from the dashboard before it expires, and review purchases at any time.

register.title: Register and choose a plan
register.body: Create a merchant account with your email and subscribe to a plan.

configure.title: Upload codes and bind the monitor
configure.body: Upload a payment code for each channel and sign in to the monitor app on an Android phone.

integrate.title: Connect your site
integrate.body: Copy your merchant ID and key, then set up ordering and callbacks following the integration guide.

notFound.title: Page not found

orders.title: Orders
orders.description: Track every payment, its status and delivery.
orders.refundConfirmed: I have verified and completed the full offline refund
orders.retryHint: Retries keep the confirmed information. Cancel and reopen to make changes.

confirm.supplement: Only supplement after verifying receipt of payment. This marks the order paid and may trigger callbacks or fulfillment.
confirm.refund: Complete the full offline refund first. This only marks the order refunded; it does not transfer funds.
confirm.resolve: Complete the full offline refund for this request first. This only updates the refund and order status; it does not transfer funds.
confirm.reject: Reject this refund request with a reason. The order will remain paid.
confirm.replay: Queue another callback for this paid order. Check callback attempts for the final result.

success.supplement: Supplement completed; the order has been updated.
